snippet.title: Tangled Crisis | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam and I'll be seeing you on release!
🎮_Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2519440/Tangled_Crisis/

Score big in this fast-paced mix of arcade action and puzzles. With a unique visual twist, every second counts. Chase the leaderboard or beat your best!

Follow on:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8PSGpbsKDP
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/longsleevegames/
